title: Scrittura Speculare
summary: Leonardo's mirror writing as a CSS transform whose reversal lives only in the rendering, not the data.
mechanism: CSS transform: scaleX(-1) mirrors the note while the DOM stays plain forward text; a button flips the whole stage so legibility is conserved but never both-at-once, and Copy/Find/screen-readers bypass the mirror entirely.
references: Leonardo da Vinci, mirror writing (the Codices)
net.art source-vs-render tradition (y-a-v-a, Silencio; La Disparition)
